...and for distortion of judgment, the same

...and for neglect of Torah, the same
as it is written: 'and I will bring a sword upon you, avenging the vengeance of the covenant...' (Lev 26:25)

and it is written: 'when I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread [in one oven, and deliver it by weight; you shall eat and not be sated]' (Lev 26:26)
and it is written: 'because, even because they despised My judgments' (Lev 26:43)
